gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all custom properties associated with a specific issue type so that I can understand the additional metadata available for that issue type.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of property keys for the specified issue type, allowing me to see what custom properties are defined.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to fetch the value of a specific property for an issue type to ensure that my application can correctly interpret the metadata associated with that issue type.
gold.ideal: The API should return the value of the specified property key for the given issue type, enabling me to access the necessary data.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to set a custom property for an issue type so that I can store additional information relevant to our workflow.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully update the specified property key with the new value for the issue type, confirming that the property has been set.

gold.user: As a product owner, I need to remove a custom property from an issue type that is no longer relevant to our processes, ensuring that our issue types remain clean and manageable.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully delete the specified property key for the issue type, confirming that the property has been removed.
